description: This file is a Gatsby Node API implementation for sourcing challenge data, creating schema types, handling file watching for challenge updates, and generating challenge pages for a curriculum platform. It manages challenge nodes, superblock structures, and challenge page creation with file system watchers.

methods.name: createSchemaCustomization
methods.description: Defines custom GraphQL schema types for challenges, specifically a QuizQuestion type.

methods.name: sourceNodes
methods.description: Sets up file watchers for challenge files, handles challenge node creation, updates, deletions, and superblock structure nodes based on challenge data.

methods.name: createPagesStatefully
methods.description: Fetches all challenge nodes, computes navigation links, and creates challenge pages with next/previous links.

methods.name: createPages
methods.description: Creates challenge pages from stored challenge nodes, invoked during Gatsby build process.
